summary: Fixed malformed focus-result reporting and unhandled rejection leakage for rejected Promise renderer returns. Final runtime suite passes 25/25 on Node v22.23.4; full composed browser matrix remains with N3.

independent_pre_fix_probe.observed: restoreFocus(undefined) committed as restored; rejected native Promise caused RuntimeFailure and a separate unhandledRejection.

runtime_tests.warning: Node emitted the existing experimental EnvHttpProxyAgent warning.

behavior: Only null means no focus; focusState records are validated before teardown.
Only restoreFocus(true) reports focus restored; false and non-boolean results fail closed after teardown.
Rejected native Promise returns receive an intrinsic rejection handler before the synchronous failure is surfaced.
Promise test verifies an own then getter capable of reentry is not read; no app Update, trace tick, or unhandled rejection occurs.

limits: No full Go build or N3 React-to-DOM browser matrix was run in this runtime lane.
The native Promise sink relies on trusted renderer structural returns and runtime reentrancy guards; it does not claim protection from arbitrary Proxy/getter behavior.
A regular function returning a thenable is detected only after invocation; after teardown this remains a fail-closed replacement error without rollback.
